card.name: Key label terms in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Marked words in drug-label instructions where a standard phrase is about to continue, such as 'missed' dose, 'pregnant', 'contraception', 'hypersensitivity' and 'infusion' reactions. Also fires on the start of a brand name after 'Withhold'.

modes.description: Words in dose-hold or missed-dose instructions that are followed by a stock continuation.
